name: Le Coq Sportif
note: French sportswear company (brand founded 1882). Controlled by Swiss holding Airesis from 2005 until the court-led sale of July 2025, when the Paris Commercial Court backed the takeover offer of a consortium led by Franco-Swiss entrepreneur Dan Mamane (SportsPro, 8 July 2025; SGB Media, 9 July 2025). SGB Media reports the consortium is backed by the Mirabaud Patrimoine Vivant investment fund; SportsPro, quoting an official release, adds backing from Japan's Itochu and Udi Avshalom. No state or state fund identified in the chain.
